name: Idaten Ikase Otoko ~Mugiko ni Aitai~
original_name: 韋駄天いかせ男 ～麦子に逢いたい～
source:
The hero is a Korean wrestler who has been working in a Brazilian farm and now comes to Japan without the proper knowledge of the language. He has an ability to excite girls with words alone so now he phones to different phones saying ridiculous phrases getting them to the state of ecstasy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名韩国摔跤手，此前一直在巴西的农场工作，如今在几乎不懂日语的情况下来到日本。他拥有仅凭言语就让女孩兴奋的能力，于是接连拨打不同的电话号码，对着听筒说些荒唐无稽的话，便能让接电话的女孩达到高潮。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
